facts.fact: Niger's director general of territorial administration announced reforms creating the ANEI agency for registration and identification of natural persons, a National Population Register and a National Civil Status Register, with secure interconnection of the systems.
facts.system: ANEI / Registre National de la Population

NER.note: A unique number for each registered person is planned, but the document does not tie it to birth registration.

facts.fact: Niger is modernising its national identification system under WURI-Niger with World Bank support, with a first registration phase to start soon in Niamey and extend to the regions, says the director general of territorial administration.
